caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure with reddish-brown skin, adorned in a white tunic with green trim, brown leggings, and brown shoes with a red stripe. The figure is draped in a red cloak that falls over the left shoulder and back, revealing a bare right shoulder and arm. The figure wears a headdress with a large brownish feather, a white cloth base, and a decorative band. Around the neck are multiple necklaces, and the figure holds a green leafy object in the right hand, while the left hand rests against the cloak. The statue stands on a rectangular, grayish-black plinth with beveled edges and decorative features. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Cigar Store Indian
